answer: The strongest lever is simple: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because echo only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. In practice velvet is enforced by the ledger itself: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any wander approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
